# Server_Side_Inference

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Running AI model inference on dedicated server hardware rather than edge or embedded devices, often for research-scale neuromorphic workloads. Provides the computational headroom needed to test complex in-network neuromorphic algorithms and validate their performance before deployment.
